# Custom allowlist for the Copilot cloud agent's firewall
# (repo Settings -> Copilot -> Internet access -> Copilot cloud agent ->
# Custom allowlist). Settings don't sync from this file -- it's the source
# of truth you copy from. One domain per line; an entry is assumed to cover
# its subdomains (schoolspring.com covers bridger.schoolspring.com).
#
# test-copilot-allowlist.R fails when a registry Job_Link/Feed_URL host or
# a URL hardcoded in a scraper file isn't covered here -- so adding a
# district means adding its domain here AND in the repo settings, or the
# agent can't fetch that page to fix it.
